ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened lower on Tuesday, with Bitcoin slipping 2.6% to $75,848 and altcoins like Ethereum and XRP falling 3‑4% amid heightened regulatory uncertainty. The Senate's rejection of the CLARITY Act and a BIS report highlighting gaps in on‑chain transfer data have added pressure, while upcoming token listings on Delta India offer limited upside.
